current_prompt.body:
IMPLEMENT a comparison-based sorting algorithm that runs in O(n) worst-case time complexity
ENSURE the algorithm is stable, preserving the relative order of equal elements
DESIGN the algorithm to sort in-place using O(1) extra space

current_plan.body:
ANALYZE the required sorting properties: O(n) worst-case time, stability, in‑place operation, and comparison‑based methodology
EVALUATE theoretical literature on comparison‑based sorting lower bounds to determine feasibility of O(n) worst‑case performance
IF feasibility is established THEN
    DESIGN the algorithmic steps that achieve the specified properties
    SPECIFY data structures and control flow needed for in‑place stable sorting
    VALIDATE the algorithm against the O(n) time requirement using worst‑case analysis
ELSE
    PREPARE a concise justification explaining why the combination of constraints cannot be satisfied
    RECOMMEND alternative sorting approaches that meet a maximal subset of the constraints
